info.title: Globetrotter Fusion Client API
info.description:
Read-only API exposing the authenticated client's bookings and invoices,
each enriched with the client's custom data fields.

## Authentication
Every request must include an `X-API-Key` header carrying a per-client
service-account key issued by Globetrotter. The key identifies the
client; all results are filtered to that client server-side. There are
no client-number query parameters — the key is the sole tenant
identifier.

## Data freshness
Responses are served from periodically refreshed snapshots of the
Globetrotter data warehouse. Snapshots typically lag the source system
by hours — do not rely on this API for real-time data.

## Query language

Both list endpoints accept four query parameters for server-side
filtering, sorting, and pagination. Each parameter may be supplied
with or without the leading `$` (`$filter` and `filter` are
equivalent). When any query parameter is used, the response gains a
`_meta` object alongside the data array.

### `$filter`

A boolean expression evaluated per row. The matching rows are returned.

| Construct       | Form                                              | Example                                                      |
|-----------------|---------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| Comparison      | `field <op> <literal>` where `<op>` is one of `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `ge`, `lt`, `le` | `bookingDate ge '2026-01-01'`                                |
| Set membership  | `field in (v1, v2, ...)` / `field nin (v1, v2, ...)` | `lineType in ('FARE', 'TAX')`                                |
| Logical         | `and`, `or`, `not`, parentheses                    | `isInternational eq true and isTicketed eq true`             |
| String contains | `contains(field, 'value')`                        | `contains(originatingAgency, 'Globetrotter')`                |
| String prefix   | `startswith(field, 'value')`                      | `startswith(recordLocator, 'FV')`                            |
| String suffix   | `endswith(field, 'value')`                        | `endswith(invoiceNumber, '01')`                              |

**Literals**

- Strings: single-quoted, with `''` to escape an embedded quote: `'O''Brien'`
- Numbers: `42`, `-3.14`, `1.5e-3`
- Booleans: `true`, `false`
- Null: `null` (use with `eq` / `ne`, e.g. `recordLocator ne null`)

**Field paths**

Use dotted notation for nested fields. Wrap labels containing spaces
in `['...']`. Example: `customDataFields['Cost Centre'] eq '12345'`.

### `$orderby`

Comma-separated list of `field [asc|desc]` clauses. Direction
defaults to `asc`. Sorting is stable across multiple clauses.

Example: `$orderby=bookingDate desc, recordLocator asc`

### `$page` and `$pageSize`

1-based pagination. `$pageSize` defaults to 50 and is capped at 500.
When either is supplied the response `_meta` carries `page`,
`pageSize`, `total`, `totalPages`, and `filteredCount`.

### Errors

Invalid query syntax returns `400` with a body identifying the
offending parameter, column, and message — see the `QueryError`
schema.

tags.name: Service Account
tags.description: Self-service management of the caller's own service account.

get.summary: List bookings for the authenticated client
get.description:
Returns every booking belonging to the client identified by the
`X-API-Key` header. Each booking is enriched with a
`customDataFields` object whose keys are the client's configured
display labels.

get.summary: List invoices for the authenticated client
get.description:
Returns every invoice belonging to the client identified by the
`X-API-Key` header. Each invoice carries its line items (sorted by
`lineNumber` ascending) and a `customDataFields` object resolved
from the related booking, if any.

post.summary: Rotate the caller's own API key
post.description:
Generates a new API key for the service account that authenticated
the request and replaces the existing key in a single operation.
The new key is returned in the response body.

The old key is invalidated immediately on success — the *current*
request still completes (authentication happened before the
rotation), but every subsequent request must use the new key.
Store the response securely; the new key is shown once and cannot
be retrieved later.

The target service account is derived entirely from the
`X-API-Key` header. There is no request body and no path or query
parameter identifying the account.

200.description: Key rotated. The body carries the new plaintext key.

get.summary: List itineraries for the authenticated client
get.description: Returns every booking belonging to the client identified by the `X-API-Key` header, each enriched with its travel segments (sorted by `segmentNumber` ascending) and a `customDataFields` object whose keys are the client's configured display labels.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Per-client service-account API key issued by Globetrotter.

clientNumber.description: Client number resolved from the authenticated service account.

count.description: Number of bookings returned in this response.

_meta.description: Present only when a query parameter was supplied.

recordLocator.description: GDS/PNR record locator. Unique per booking.

originatingAgency.description: Name of the agency that created the booking.

modifiedAt.description:
Timestamp of the most recent modification, truncated to minute
resolution. Format `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM` (no seconds, no timezone
suffix — interpret as the source system's local time).

isTicketed.description: True when at least one segment of the booking has been ticketed.

isInternational.description: True when the trip crosses an international border.

tripStartLocal.description:
Local-time start of the trip at the origin, minute resolution.
Format `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM`.

tripEndLocal.description:
Local-time end of the trip at the final destination, minute
resolution. Format `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM`.

_meta.description: Present only when a query parameter was supplied.

company.description:
Issuing company entity. Invoice numbers may be reused across
companies, so `(company, invoiceNumber)` is the composite
identity of an invoice.

recordLocator.description:
Linked booking record locator. Null when the invoice does not
originate from a tracked booking.

obtSource.description: Online Booking Tool source identifier, if the booking originated in one.

lineItems.description: Line items belonging to this invoice, sorted by `lineNumber` ascending.

lineNumber.description: Position of this line within its invoice. Unique per invoice.

lineType.description: Category of the line (e.g. fare, fee, tax).

unitPrice.description: Decimal price per unit (up to 5 decimal places).

lineDiscountAmount.description: Discount applied to this line, in invoice currency.

gstPercent.description: GST rate applied to this line, as a percentage (e.g. 10 for 10%).

CustomDataFields.description:
Client-defined custom data captured at booking time and carried
through to any invoices generated from that booking.

Keys are the client's configured display labels (e.g. "Cost
Centre", "Project Code"). Values are the captured strings. Both
the set of keys and their wording are entirely client-specific —
an empty object means no custom data was captured for this record
(or the client has none configured).

Empty-string values are omitted; absent keys mean the field was
either blank or not configured.

error.example: Unauthenticated: no service account on request

QueryMeta.description: Pagination / filtering metadata. Present on responses when at least one query parameter (`$filter`, `$orderby`, `$page`, `$pageSize`) was supplied.

page.description: Page number that was returned (1-based). Present only when paging was applied.

pageSize.description: Page size used. Present only when paging was applied.

total.description: Total rows after filtering, before paging.

totalPages.description: Total pages available at the current `pageSize`. Present only when paging was applied.

QueryError.description: Returned when a query parameter fails to parse.

message.example: Expected comparison operator after field 'bookingDate' at column 13 but found 'foo'

column.description: Zero-based column in the input where parsing failed.

input.description: The raw input string supplied for the parameter.

clientNumber.description: Client number resolved from the authenticated service account.

count.description: Number of itineraries returned in this response.

_meta.description: Present only when a query parameter was supplied.

Itinerary.description: A booking together with its ordered travel segments. All booking fields and the booking-level `customDataFields` apply unchanged; `segments` carries the per-leg detail.

segments.description: Travel segments for this booking, sorted by `segmentNumber` ascending.

RotateApiKeyResponse.description:
Result of a successful self-service API key rotation. The `apiKey`
field is the new plaintext key and replaces the value used to
authenticate this request.

id.description: Stable identifier of the rotated service account.

name.description: Display name of the service account.

apiKey.description: The newly generated API key, base64-encoded (64 characters from 48 bytes of cryptographic randomness). Treat as a secret — it cannot be retrieved later.

rotatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the rotation was persisted (RFC 3339 with offset).

BookingSegment.description: A single leg of a booking (a flight, hotel night, car-hire period, etc.).

segmentNumber.description: Position of this segment within its booking. Sort order key.

startLocal.description: Local-time start of the segment at the origin, minute resolution. Format `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM`. Null if not known.

endLocal.description: Local-time end of the segment at the destination, minute resolution. Format `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM`. Null if not known.

origin.description: IATA city/airport code for the origin (3 chars), or null for non-spatial segments.

destination.description: IATA city/airport code for the destination (3 chars), or null for non-spatial segments.

vendor.description: IATA carrier code or supplier identifier (2 chars).

code.description: Segment-specific code (e.g. flight number, hotel property code, fare class).

status.description: GDS status code (2 chars, e.g. `HK` confirmed, `XX` cancelled).

Filter.name: $filter
Filter.description: Boolean expression for server-side filtering. See the **Query language** section of this document for the full grammar. Accepts `$filter` or `filter` (case-insensitive).

OrderBy.name: $orderby
OrderBy.description: Comma-separated sort clauses, each `field [asc|desc]`. Direction defaults to `asc`. Multiple clauses are applied left-to-right (primary, secondary, ...).

PageSize.name: $pageSize
PageSize.description: Page size. Defaults to 50, hard-capped at 500.
